title: Chic&Cozy Modern Architecture Townhouse
description:
Indulge in comfort and style at this tastefully appointed home. The residence features wood flooring, bright splashes of color, contrasting textures and motifs, an open-plan main space, and an outdoor dining area with a fire pit. Live like a local, mere steps away from coffee stops, breweries, and top-rated restaurants.

*I apologize but we do not rent to locals*

The space
Welcome to Nashville! This property is a beautiful 3 story 1,675 sq ft home located in East Nashville, just steps away from breweries, coffee shops, and amazing restaurants!

With high-end interior finishes and chic decorative styling, the 3rd story rooftop deck with a view will allow you to experience Nashville to the fullest while feeling right at home.

It has 2 bedrooms, a queen on the 1st floor and a king on the 3rd floor. Each bedroom has a full bath. The 2nd floor living room/dining room has a half bath with sleeping arrangements for 1-2 more guests.  

*1st floor
-Beautiful stained concrete floor!
-Guest room with full bathroom and large closet.
-Washer & Dryer.
-32" HDTV!
-Spacious 2 Car Garage

*2nd floor
-All hardwood floor finishing.
-Spacious open living area with a 65” HDTV and large comfortable couch and lounge chair (Couch and Air Mattress available for sleeping arrangements for 1-2 guests).
-Large modern kitchen with a 4 person granite counter-top!
-Comfortable dining area to eat at or to get a fun game going!
-1/2 bathroom.

*3rd floor
-All hardwood floor finishing.
-Master bedroom with a large gorgeous master bathroom
-55" HDTV!
-Approximately 220 SQ*FT roof-deck with a fire pit and seating area with a beautiful view! (Downtown view in fall and winter!)

Free WiFi! Access to Netflix, Amazon TV, Alexa,

With the modern high-end finishes, unique/hip locale in East Nash, being 3.5 miles (~$8-10 Uber/Lyft) from downtown Nashville, and close proximity to the airport (15-20 min. drive)... you can’t go wrong with this spacious 3 story town-home! Book with us today!

Short Term Rental Permit # is listed in pictures (Airbnb will not allow me to post here).

Guest access
Access to entire home (including garage).
